story: Perplexity launches Teammates, always-on AI agents

sources.name: Lilach Bullock, AI News for Small Business, 8 Nov 2026

segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: AI "teammates" that keep working after you close the chat
segments.narration: Perplexity just launched AI teammates that keep working after you close the chat.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: Give it a goal, not a prompt
segments.point: Watch competitor prices · draft support replies
segments.narration: Give one an ongoing goal, like watching competitor prices or drafting support replies.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: Its own browser. Works in the background.
segments.point: Checks in when it needs your approval
segments.narration: It works in its own browser, and checks in when it needs your approval.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: A part-time assistant for repetitive work
segments.point: Catch: Max plan only, about $200 a month
segments.narration: For a small business, that's a part-time assistant for repetitive work. The catch: it's only on the Max plan, about two hundred dollars a month.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Keep refunds, prices and customers behind your approval
segments.point: Let the agent draft. You decide.
segments.narration: Our take: let it draft, but keep refunds and prices behind your approval.
